plugins.title: Hide Root
plugins.shortDescription: Hide root access from detection systems

fullDetails.about: A plugin designed to conceal root access on your device, preventing apps and services from detecting modified system status.

plugins.title: Ad Blocker
plugins.shortDescription: Block ads system-wide on your device

fullDetails.about: An advanced ad blocking plugin that removes advertisements from apps, browsers, and games without requiring root access.

plugins.title: Battery Saver
plugins.shortDescription: Optimize battery performance and extend life

fullDetails.about: Intelligent battery optimization plugin that manages background processes, reduces power consumption, and extends device battery life.
